alex: Morning — quick async standup.
alex: What I did: rolled forward canary for batching service, ran a short load test, merged PR #452 (perf fixes).
alex: Blockers: flaky alert on kv-cache eviction firing during high p95; haven't reproduced locally.
alex: Today: dig into alert noise, add heap profiling to worker-3, review oncall rotation.
neha: Re: kv-cache alert — saw the same spike on Friday, suspect a GC-induced eviction. Added short-term tracing to worker-3.
chris: PR #452: left one comment about metric labels, minor. pinging @taylor for review.
taylor: On it, will review tonight and push a follow-up if needed.
matt: FYI oncall: PD sent a sev3 for region-eu yesterday, resolved by scaling pods. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache :white_check_mark:
alex: Can you paste the alert rule? the alert text in pager wasn't very helpful.
neha: Here's the rule:
```
alert: KVCacheEvictionSpike
expr: sum by(instance)(rate(kv_cache_evictions[5m])) > 100
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```
neha: I'm going to lower threshold for worker-3 and add an instance annotation to help triage.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged — PD-8766 assigned to matt. :bell:
chris: Quick calendar note: I need time off 2026-04-15 -> 2026-04-20, can we rotate me out? @matt
matt: noted, I'll swap with taylor and confirm.
alex: Blocker update: can't reproduce locally, will deploy a debug build with heap-profiling to staging at 10:30 PST and attach pprof; will post link when up.
neha: I'll add a dashboard tile for eviction-rate p99 and an alert suppression for the canary window.
alex: Thanks all. If no one objects, I'll follow up here after the staging run. :thumbsup:
